name: Panorama Farms Invitational
headline: Panorama Farms Invitational
summary: Final: Women: Virginia Tech won 20-36 over No. 16 Virginia, whose Gillian Bushee won the 6K in 20:19.6; Wingate's women placed fifth (151) behind Charlotte and Delaware. Men: Virginia Tech's George Couttie won the 8K in 23:43.9 and the Hokies beat Virginia 31-51, with No. 1 Wingate third (75) and Norfolk State fourth (112).
